correctness.rationale: For fixed 0<c,gamma<1, positive weights satisfying p_j=c j^{-gamma} exist uniquely. Conditional weighted-depth martingale increments yield T_n-ET_n=sum[1+(n-j)p_j]xi_j; independent rational parent-tree enumeration to n=6 confirmed the exact variance. The innovation recurrence v_(j+1)=(1-p_j^2)v_j+p_j(1-p_j) is derived by two-population variance. Its positive-kernel asymptotics split at gamma=1/2; power-sum convolution and summability split again at 2/3, recovering five exact constants and n-scale a.s./L2 martingale convergence only for gamma>2/3. No distributional limit below threshold is claimed.
